summary: How much seed to pull and how much space (bed feet or containers) to plan for a seedling order. Legacy: the Calculations tab of the NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS form. GrowHub: the Planning step of /orders (OrderPlanningComponent).

inputs.note: Legacy quantities are in thousands; GrowHub's are whole seedlings. The mapping sheet already says 'Value x1000'.
Per the mapping sheet; the GrowHub calculations don't read it.

rules.title: Pure live seed (viable seeds per pound)

legacy.formula: seeds/lb × germ% × purity%. If it comes out 0 (no test data), the Calculate button refuses to compute seed and says "No test data entered to calculate source".

refs.code: Pure_Live_Seed = [GROSS_SOURCE_PER_UNIT]*([SOURCE_GERM_PCT]/100)*([SOURCE_PURITY_PCT]/100)

If Pure_Live_Seed > 0 Then
REQ = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!TOTAL_REQUEST * 1000)
PLS = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!GROSS_SOURCE_PER_UNIT * _
      (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_GERM_PCT / 100) * _
      (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_PURITY_PCT / 100))
MsgBox "No test data entered to calculate source. Calculating containers only"

growhub.formula: Same product, inlined in each calculation. But a germ% or purity% of 0 or blank is treated as 100%, so the calculation runs as if the seed were perfect.

rules.impact: With no test data, GrowHub silently assumes 100% germination and purity. It then under-orders seed by whatever the real germ and purity would have been, where legacy would have stopped.
rules.question: Should GrowHub block or warn when germ or purity is missing, as legacy did?

rules.title: Harvest factor product (and the multiply/divide operator)

legacy.formula: HFn = factor when the factor code's operator is '*', otherwise 10000 / factor (the inverse). Product = HF1 × HF2 × HF3 × HF4 × Harvest ASF, each as a fraction of 100.

refs.code: HF1 = IIf([HF1_Formula_OP]="*",[HARVEST_FACTOR_1],(10000/[HARVEST_FACTOR_1]))
Harvest_Factor = ([HF1]/100)*([HF2]/100)*([HF3]/100)*([HF4]/100)*([HARVEST_ASF_ADJUSTMENT]/100)*100

Private Sub Harvest_Factor_Tip_Click()

    MsgBox "Harvest Factors GREATER THAN 100% with an OP of / will INCREASE the amount of seed " & _
            "and with an OP of * will REDUCE the amount of seed." & _
            "   Harvest Factors LESS THAN than 100% with an OP of / will REDUCE the amount of seed " & _
            "and with an OP of * will INCREASE the amount of seed." & _
            "   A Harvest ASF adjustment GREATER THAN 100% will REDUCE the amount of seed and LESS THAN 100 " & _
            "will INCREASE the amount of seed", vbInformation, _
            "Harvest Factor Help"

End Sub

growhub.formula: factor1/100 × factor2/100 × factor3/100. There's no operator, no factor 4 and no Harvest ASF. A blank factor counts as 1.

rules.impact: Any factor whose code uses the '/' operator moves the result the wrong way in GrowHub: 125 multiplies instead of dividing. The Access factor migration (admin/bin/access-migrations/species-product-factors-seed.ts) copies HARVEST_FACTOR_1–3 as-is and drops factor 4. In the four nurseries' NMIS_FACTORS exports, factor 4 is always 100, so dropping it from the defaults is harmless. On agreement lots it isn't: in the Oracle-era export (seed/NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.json), 1,821 of 8,149 lots override factor 4, and 21 set a Harvest ASF.
rules.evidence: seed/access/*/NMIS_FACTORS.xml: HARVEST_FACTOR_4 = 100 in all 2,376 rows. seed/NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.json: HARVEST_FACTOR_4 ≠ 100 on 1,821 lots.
rules.question: Which factor codes use the inverse operator (NMIS_FACTOR_CODES.FORMULA_INVERSE)? That table isn't in the frontend or the XML exports. Were those values converted before migration?

rules.title: Seed required (lb)

legacy.formula: (TOTAL_REQUEST × 1000) ÷ (pure live seed × harvest factor product × Harvest ASF), rounded to 3 decimals. The Calculate button leaves thinning probability out. A separate display field, Calc_Source, shows the figure with thinning included.

refs.code:
If Pure_Live_Seed > 0 Then
REQ = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!TOTAL_REQUEST * 1000)
PLS = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!GROSS_SOURCE_PER_UNIT * _
      (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_GERM_PCT / 100) * _
      (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_PURITY_PCT / 100))
ASF = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HARVEST_ASF_ADJUSTMENT / 100)
HARVEST_FACTOR = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HF1 / 100) * _
                 (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HF2 / 100) * _
                 (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HF3 / 100) * _
                 (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HF4 / 100)
Source_Req = Round((REQ / (PLS * HARVEST_FACTOR * ASF)), 3)
Calc_Source = IIf([Pure_Live_Seed]>0,Round(([TOTAL_REQUEST]*1000)/[Pure_Live_Seed]/(([HF]/100)*[THINNING_PROBABILITY_PCT]/100),3),"NA")

growhub.formula: seedlings ÷ (factor1 × factor2 × factor3 × thinning × past inventory performance × germ × purity × seeds/lb), rounded to 3 decimals, × 453.6 when the source lot is measured in grams.

rules.impact: GrowHub always includes thinning and past performance in the seed figure. Legacy's saved SOURCE_REQUIRED excluded thinning. Even with the same inputs, GrowHub asks for more seed whenever thinning or past performance is below 100%.
rules.question: Should the saved seed quantity include thinning (like legacy's Calc_Source display) or not (like legacy's Calculate button)?

rules.title: Seed balance check when setting seed required

legacy.formula: If seed required is more than the lot's balance: zero-balance lots show "This is a Zero Balance Lot!". Otherwise seed required is capped at the balance, with "Insufficient Seed". The same check runs whenever seed required is edited.

refs.code:
If Source_Req <= Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS![Seed_Balance Query subform]![Sum Of ACTIVITY_UNITS] Then
        Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_REQUIRED = Source_Req
    Else
        If Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS![Seed_Balance Query subform]![Sum Of ACTIVITY_UNITS] >= 0 Then
            If Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS![Seed_Balance Query subform]![Sum Of ACTIVITY_UNITS] < 0.0001 Then
                MsgBox "This is a Zero Balance Lot!"
                Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_REQUIRED = Source_Req
            Else
                Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_REQUIRED = Round(Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS![Seed_Balance Query subform]![Sum Of ACTIVITY_UNITS], 3)
                MsgBox "Insufficient Seed. Check Calculated for Request Adjustment"
            End If
        Else
            Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_REQUIRED = Source_Req
            MsgBox "Undetermined amount of source material."

Private Sub SOURCE_REQUIRED_AfterUpdate()

    If Not IsNull(SOURCE_REQUIRED) Then
        If Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS![Seed_Balance Query subform]![Sum Of ACTIVITY_UNITS] < SOURCE_REQUIRED Then
        If Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS![Seed_Balance Query subform]![Sum Of ACTIVITY_UNITS] < 0.0001 Then
            MsgBox "This is a Zero Balance Lot!"
            'Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_REQUIRED = Source_Req
        Else
            'Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_REQUIRED = Round(Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS![Seed_Balance Query subform]![Sum of Activity_Units], 3)
            MsgBox "Insufficient Seed. Check Calculated for Request Adjustment"
        End If
        End If
    End If

End Sub

growhub.formula: Two checks, neither on the planning step's figure. (1) The grow-request step sets an 'insufficient balance' flag when growRequest.estimatedLbsOfSeed is more than the lot balance (a warning, not a cap). (2) The production step's form validator rejects a withdrawal larger than the lot balance.

rules.impact: Legacy capped the planned seed at the balance as soon as it was calculated. GrowHub lets planning compute and save more seed than the lot holds, flags it on the grow request, and stops it at withdrawal.
rules.question: Is a warning at grow request plus a hard stop at withdrawal enough, or should planning cap or warn as legacy did?

rules.title: Which seed balance

legacy.formula: Sum of activity units for the lot over activity codes whose balance effect isn't NOEFFECT, with grams converted to pounds (× 0.002204623). The planning form's version (Seed_Balance3) has no date filter. A sibling query (Seed_Balance2) only counts activities dated today or earlier.

refs.code: MAKE TABLE NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.CN, [Seed_Balance3 Query].[Sum Of ACTIVITY_UNITS], "LB" AS LastOfUNIT_CODE FROM NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS, Seed_Balance3 Query JOIN NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS↔Seed_Balance3 Query ON NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.CN = [Seed_Balance3 Query].SOURCE_LOT_CN

SELECT NMIS_ID_ACTIVITIES.SOURCE_LOT_CN, Round(Sum(IIf([NMIS_ID_ACTIVITIES].[unit_Code]="G",[ACTIVITY_UNITS]*0.002204623,[Activity_Units])),4) AS Sum Of ACTIVITY_UNITS, "LB" AS UNIT_CODE FROM NMIS_ACTIVITY_CODES, NMIS_ID_ACTIVITIES JOIN NMIS_ACTIVITY_CODES↔NMIS_ID_ACTIVITIES ON NMIS_ACTIVITY_CODES.ACTIVITY_CODE = NMIS_ID_ACTIVITIES.ACTIVITY_CODE JOIN NMIS_ACTIVITY_CODES↔NMIS_ID_ACTIVITIES ON NMIS_ACTIVITY_CODES.ACTIVITY_CODE = NMIS_ID_ACTIVITIES.ACTIVITY_CODE WHERE (((NMIS_ACTIVITY_CODES.BALANCE_EFFECT)<>"NOEFFECT")) GROUP BY NMIS_ID_ACTIVITIES.SOURCE_LOT_CN, "LB"

SELECT NMIS_ID_ACTIVITIES.SOURCE_LOT_CN, Round(Sum(IIf([NMIS_ID_ACTIVITIES].[unit_Code]="G",[ACTIVITY_UNITS]*0.002204623,[Activity_Units])),4) AS Sum Of ACTIVITY_UNITS, "LB" AS UNIT_CODE, NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.ID, NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.CATEGORY_CODE FROM NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS, NMIS_ACTIVITY_CODES, NMIS_ID_ACTIVITIES JOIN NMIS_ACTIVITY_CODES↔NMIS_ID_ACTIVITIES ON NMIS_ACTIVITY_CODES.ACTIVITY_CODE = NMIS_ID_ACTIVITIES.ACTIVITY_CODE JOIN NMIS_ACTIVITY_CODES↔NMIS_ID_ACTIVITIES ON NMIS_ACTIVITY_CODES.ACTIVITY_CODE = NMIS_ID_ACTIVITIES.ACTIVITY_CODE JOIN NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS↔NMIS_ID_ACTIVITIES ON NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.CN = NMIS_ID_ACTIVITIES.SOURCE_LOT_CN WHERE (((NMIS_ACTIVITY_CODES.BALANCE_EFFECT)<>"NOEFFECT") AND ((NMIS_ID_ACTIVITIES.ACTIVITY_DATE)<=Date())) GROUP BY NMIS_ID_ACTIVITIES.SOURCE_LOT_CN, "LB", NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.ID, NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.CATEGORY_CODE

growhub.formula: source_lot.lotBalance, maintained by the server from lot transactions.

rules.impact: Future-dated activities count toward the legacy planning balance. The activity-code crosswalk (Reference data › Activity codes) decides which codes move the GrowHub balance, and only 33% of Access codes are mapped so far.
rules.question: Does GrowHub's lotBalance include future-dated activities?

rules.title: Which test results feed planning

legacy.formula: "Use Last Test Data" copies germ%, purity%, seeds/lb and stratified from one record: the lot's most recent test (max TEST_DATE). All four values come from that one test. Two tests on the same date give duplicate rows.

MAKE TABLE NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.ID, [NMIS_SOURCE_LastTestDate Query].SOURCE_LOT_CN, NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS.TEST_DATE, NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS.GROSS_SOURCE_PER_UNIT, NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS.STRATIFIED, NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS.GERM_PCT, NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS.PURITY_PCT, NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS.CHECK_STRAT, NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS.FILLED_PCT, NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS.TYPE_OF_TEST FROM NMIS_SOURCE_LastTestDate Query, NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS, NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS JOIN NMIS_SOURCE_LastTestDate Query↔NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS ON [NMIS_SOURCE_LastTestDate Query].MaxOfTEST_DATE = NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS.TEST_DATE JOIN NMIS_SOURCE_LastTestDate Query↔NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS ON [NMIS_SOURCE_LastTestDate Query].SOURCE_LOT_CN = NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS.SOURCE_LOT_CN JOIN NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS↔NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS ON NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.CN = NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS.SOURCE_LOT_CN ORDER BY NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.ID

SELECT NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS.SOURCE_LOT_CN, Max(NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS.TEST_DATE) AS MaxOfTEST_DATE, Max(NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS.Index) AS MaxOfIndex FROM NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS, NMIS_SOURCE_LastTestDate1 Query JOIN NMIS_SOURCE_LastTestDate1 Query↔NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS ON [NMIS_SOURCE_LastTestDate1 Query].SOURCE_LOT_CN = NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS.SOURCE_LOT_CN JOIN NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS↔NMIS_SOURCE_LastTestDate1 Query ON NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS.TEST_DATE = [NMIS_SOURCE_LastTestDate1 Query].MaxOfTEST_DATE GROUP BY NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS.SOURCE_LOT_CN ORDER BY NMIS_SOURCE_TESTS.SOURCE_LOT_CN

growhub.formula: Takes the most recent test of each type separately: germ from t2, purity from t4, seeds/lb from t7. Fills them in when the field is empty or the source lot changes.

rules.impact: In GrowHub, germ, purity and seeds/lb can come from different test dates. TZ germination tests (t3, which the Access test migration creates for TZ / TZ-P / T-P-C) are never used for germ. Also, getSeedsPerPound runs after the tests are sorted newest-first, so its loop keeps the oldest t7. That variable looks display-only, since the form field uses the newest t7, but it's worth checking.
rules.question: Should TZ (t3) results count as germination in planning?

rules.title: Choosing the default factors

legacy.formula: Automatic. Takes the NMIS_FACTORS row for the species product where the client ID starts with LIKE_ASSOCIATE. Otherwise it takes a generic row (LIKE_ASSOCIATE blank) whose germ range covers the lot's germ%. Client rows sort first. The elevation range is selected but not used. "Use Default Factors" copies harvest factors 1–4, container factors 1–3 and desired density, and resets thinning and container probability to 100%.

refs.code: SELECT NMIS_FACTORS.SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN, NMIS_FACTORS.LIKE_ASSOCIATE, NMIS_FACTORS.GERM_MIN, NMIS_FACTORS.GERM_MAX, NMIS_FACTORS.HARVEST_FACTOR_1, NMIS_FACTORS.HARVEST_FACTOR_2, NMIS_FACTORS.HARVEST_FACTOR_3, NMIS_FACTORS.HARVEST_FACTOR_4, NMIS_FACTORS.HARVEST_FACTOR, NMIS_FACTORS.CONTAINER_FACTOR_1, NMIS_FACTORS.CONTAINER_FACTOR_2, NMIS_FACTORS.CONTAINER_FACTOR_3, NMIS_FACTORS.CONTAINER_FACTOR, NMIS_FACTORS.DESIRED_DENSITY, NMIS_FACTORS.MAXIMUM_DENSITY, NMIS_FACTORS.SOURCE_PER_AGREEMENT_UNIT, NMIS_FACTORS.GROSS_PER_CONTAINER, [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS subform1].[Form]![CLIENT_ASSOCIATE] AS Associate, NMIS_FACTORS.ELEVATION_MIN, NMIS_FACTORS.ELEVATION_MAX FROM NMIS_FACTORS WHERE (((NMIS_FACTORS.SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN)=[Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN]) AND (([Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS subform1].[Form]![CLIENT_ASSOCIATE]) Like IIf([like_associate] Is Not Null,[like_associate] & "*",[like_associate]))) OR (((NMIS_FACTORS.SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN)=[Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN]) AND ((NMIS_FACTORS.LIKE_ASSOCIATE) Is Null) AND ((NMIS_FACTORS.GERM_MIN)<=Nz([Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![SOURCE_GERM_PCT],0)) AND ((NMIS_FACTORS.GERM_MAX)>=Nz([Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![SOURCE_GERM_PCT],100))) ORDER BY NMIS_FACTORS.LIKE_ASSOCIATE DESC;

growhub.formula: Manual. The planner picks from a dropdown of every seed factor for the species product, labelled with client, elevation and germ range. Choosing one copies factor1–3 only.

rules.impact: GrowHub doesn't pre-select the client- or germ-matched row, and choosing a factor doesn't set desired density or reset thinning.
rules.question: Keep factor selection manual, or pre-select using legacy's client-prefix / germ-range rule?

rules.title: Bareroot space (bed feet / seedbed containers)

legacy.formula: For seedbed (SB) stock: containers = (seed required × pure live seed) × container factor product ÷ (target density × cells per container) × container ASF. It starts from the seed actually being sown.

refs.code:
If [Type_of_Container] = "SB" Then
    Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!EST_CONTAINERS_REQUIRED = _
    ((Source_Req2 * PLS) * CONTAINER_FACTOR / (TARGET_DENSITY * Cells_Per_Container) * _
      CONTAINER_ASF)

Private Sub SOURCE_REQUIRED_Exit(Cancel As Integer)
'Relock Source_Required

    If [SOURCE_REQUIRED].Locked = False Then
        [SOURCE_REQUIRED].Locked = True
    End If

'Recalculate the container needs for bareroot if the source amount is changed

   If [Type_of_Container] = "SB" Then

    Dim ASF As Double
    Dim Source_Req2 As Double
    Dim PLS As Double
    Dim CF1 As Double
    Dim CF2 As Double
    Dim CF3 As Double
    Dim TARGET_DENSITY As Double
    Dim Cells_Per_Container As Double
    Dim CONTAINER_ASF As Double
    Dim CONTAINER_FACTOR As Double


'Calculate Grow Containers
    If IsNull(SOURCE_REQUIRED) Then
       MsgBox "No Source Required Entered"
    Else
    If [DESIRED_DENSITY] > 0 Then
        Source_Req2 = Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_REQUIRED
        If Not IsNull(Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!GROSS_SOURCE_PER_UNIT) Then
            PLS = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!GROSS_SOURCE_PER_UNIT * _
                (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_GERM_PCT / 100) * _
                (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_PURITY_PCT / 100))
        End If
        CF1 = [CF1A] / 100
        CF2 = [CF2A] / 100
        CF3 = [CF3A] / 100
        TARGET_DENSITY = [DESIRED_DENSITY]
        Cells_Per_Container = _
            [NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS_BEGIN_CONTAINER subform1]![Cells_Per_Container]
        CONTAINER_ASF = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!CONTAINER_ASF_ADJUSTMENT / 100)
        CONTAINER_FACTOR = CF1 * CF2 * CF3

        Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!EST_CONTAINERS_REQUIRED = _
                ((Source_Req2 * PLS) * CONTAINER_FACTOR / (TARGET_DENSITY * Cells_Per_Container) * _
                  CONTAINER_ASF)
    Else
        MsgBox "No target density has been entered. Est Containers will not be calculated."
    End If
    End If
   End If

End Sub

growhub.formula: round(((seedlings ÷ (factor1 × factor2 × factor3 × past performance)) × bareroot space) ÷ (target density × cells per container × survival)). It starts from the request and uses harvest factors, not container factors.

rules.impact: Different starting point (request vs seed sown) and different factors. Legacy recalculated space from the seed actually sown whenever seed required was edited. GrowHub's space doesn't move when the planner adjusts seed.
rules.question: Should bareroot space follow the seed being sown (legacy) or the seedlings requested (GrowHub)?

rules.title: Legacy uses three different container formulas

legacy.formula:
The same EST_CONTAINERS_REQUIRED is recalculated by different handlers with different formulas:
• Calculate button: × container factor, + 0.35, no container ASF
• leaving Container ASF or Container Factor 1–3: × container factor × container ASF, no + 0.35
• leaving Desired Density: × container ASF + 0.35, no container factor
So the stored value depends on which field the user left last.

rules.title: Seeds-per-cell (SPC) adjustment

legacy.formula: Seed for SPC = cells per container × seeds per cell × containers ÷ seeds/lb (gross seeds/lb, not pure live seed). Containers for SPC = seed required × seeds/lb ÷ (cells × seeds per cell). The "Use" buttons then back-solve a percentage into harvest factor 4 / container factor 3 or thinning / container probability so the main formulas reproduce the SPC figure.

refs.code: Source_Required_by_spc = IIf([Pure_Live_Seed]>0,Round(([NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS_BEGIN_CONTAINER subform1].[Form]![CELLS_PER_CONTAINER]*[seed_per_cell_to_use])*[EST_CONTAINERS_REQUIRED]/[GROSS_SOURCE_PER_UNIT],3),"NA")

                THINNING_PROBABILITY_PCT = Round(SOURCE_REQUIRED / Source_Required_by_spc * 100, 0)

refs.code:
calculateSeedlingYield(orderForm: any, seedQuantity: number): number {
  let growRecControls =
    orderForm.controls.growRequest.controls.planning.controls[this.planningCycleIndex].controls;
  let totalAdjustmentFactor;
  if (this.isBareroot) {
    totalAdjustmentFactor =
      (growRecControls.factor1.value !== null && !isNaN(growRecControls.factor1.value)
        ? growRecControls.factor1.value / 100
        : 1) *
      (growRecControls.factor2.value !== null && !isNaN(growRecControls.factor2.value)
        ? growRecControls.factor2.value / 100
        : 1) *
      (growRecControls.factor3.value !== null && !isNaN(growRecControls.factor3.value)
        ? growRecControls.factor3.value / 100
        : 1) *
      (growRecControls.germPercent.value !== null && !isNaN(growRecControls.germPercent.value)
        ? growRecControls.germPercent.value / 100
        : 1) *
      (growRecControls.purityPercent.value !== null && !isNaN(growRecControls.purityPercent.value)
        ? growRecControls.purityPercent.value / 100
        : 1) *
      (growRecControls.pastInventoryPerformance.value !== null &&
      !isNaN(growRecControls.pastInventoryPerformance.value)
        ? growRecControls.pastInventoryPerformance.value / 100
        : 1) *
      growRecControls.seedPerPound.value;
  } else {
    totalAdjustmentFactor =
      (growRecControls.factor1.value !== null && !isNaN(growRecControls.factor1.value)
        ? growRecControls.factor1.value / 100
        : 1) *
      (growRecControls.factor2.value !== null && !isNaN(growRecControls.factor2.value)
        ? growRecControls.factor2.value / 100
        : 1) *
      (growRecControls.factor3.value !== null && !isNaN(growRecControls.factor3.value)
        ? growRecControls.factor3.value / 100
        : 1) *
      (growRecControls.germPercent.value !== null && !isNaN(growRecControls.germPercent.value)
        ? growRecControls.germPercent.value / 100
        : 1) *
      (growRecControls.purityPercent.value !== null && !isNaN(growRecControls.purityPercent.value)
        ? growRecControls.purityPercent.value / 100
        : 1) *
      (growRecControls.thinningProbability.value !== null &&
      !isNaN(growRecControls.thinningProbability.value)
        ? growRecControls.thinningProbability.value / 100
        : 1) *
      (growRecControls.pastInventoryPerformance.value !== null &&
      !isNaN(growRecControls.pastInventoryPerformance.value)
        ? growRecControls.pastInventoryPerformance.value / 100
        : 1) *
      growRecControls.seedPerPound.value;
  }

  totalAdjustmentFactor = Number(totalAdjustmentFactor.toFixed(3));

  //Seed Quantity * Seeds Per Pound * Germination * Purity * Survival * Harvest * Shippable * Past Performance
  let seedYield = Math.round(seedQuantity * totalAdjustmentFactor);

  return seedYield;
}
